sharp_single_separator_relaxation.description: Within the relaxation consisting only of the three class-total equalities and the T165 separator, the bound 115/120663 is attained by taking target-minus-x equal to epsilon times the sign of the centered coefficient, using one zero R coefficient with +epsilon to restore the R class-total equality.

scope: Quantitative consequence on the T165 seven-window boundary face for probability laws whose aggregate P, Q, R totals match C030. It proves at least one of the 89 named event marginals differs from its C030 class target by at least 115/120663. The constant is optimal for the single T165 separator modulo the three class-total equalities, not claimed optimal for the full boundary polytope. No full15 solution or new Hadwiger-Nelson bound.
